title: Catalog builder subtracts foreign star pointers before validating membership
summary: indigo_solver_catalog_build subtracts each quad star pointer from stars before checking range. Foreign-object subtraction is undefined; original and006-fixed sanitizer source both accept the outside pointer in index_file_roundtrip and fail its rejection assertion, while normal suite passes. Next: validate membership/alignment before arithmetic and retain regression across layouts. No exploitability claim.
evidence: indigo_drivers/agent_solver/indigo_solver.c:1052–1058; findings.md and original/fixed sanitizer evidence in verification.md.
